mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is currently a mild 66 degrees, feeling like 68, under partly cloudy skies over Reddan Soccer Park. We have a lovely waxing crescent moon shining tonight, though there are no visible space station passes.

The City of Verona is actively promoting sustainability. Residents can now take advantage of rebates for rain barrels, smart toilets, and solar installations. Additionally, apartment dwellers can compost easily by visiting the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue.
We have plenty of local events coming up, including live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Louie on July 19th, and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park on July 22nd.
Looking at our weekly police recap, last Thursday morning, officers responded to a two vehicle crash at County Highway PB and American Way where a driver failed to yield, causing minor injuries.

Today's mouthwatering Flavor of the Day is Turtle, featuring a rich blend of chocolate, caramel, and pecans. Since the store is currently closed, you can look forward to them opening at 10:00 AM today to get your fix. Tomorrow's flavor is still a mystery, so stay tuned!
